propositions.statement: Level 2 (computational validity) asks whether the mathematical theory can actually be computed, once Level 1 makes sense.

propositions.statement: O-7 to O-10: 208 uncited prior art; 209 not an algebra; 210 matrix populated but weak; 212-214 produce no data.

propositions.statement: O-11/O-12: no fabricated results; arithmetic correct where performed.
propositions.quote: No arithmetic error found in the corpus.

propositions.statement: O-13: measurement discipline is bimodal, with correct refusals and scale violations plus the E-ladder calibration failure.
propositions.quote: Measurement discipline is bimodal: five correct refusals, six scale violations.

propositions.statement: O-18: the philosophical layer is handled correctly, maintaining the lens/proof boundary throughout.

propositions.statement: O-19: under its own rules the band fails its own standards.
propositions.quote: Under the band's own rules, the band fails its own standards.

propositions.statement: O-20: the band is high-quality method specification with about two dozen durable distinctions and zero instances.
propositions.quote: The band has learned not to fabricate. It has not yet learned to gather.

propositions.statement: Repair items are verifier proposals, not findings, not established by corpus, with no authority.
